label: Mid-input steps (t=3-5) of sequences beginning m k / k k (sparse, unresolved conjunction)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.0085% of steps). It fires almost only in the original phase at t=3-5 (97% of mass; a few weak hits on <DEL>, none in the copy phase) and almost only in sequences whose first token is m (83% of mass) or k (14%). The strongest activations come when k appears early (orig(1)==k) and the current input is k again, or the previous token is g/u/2 (e.g. m k k 2 [k], m k w b [k], k k u [k]). But these context conditions are far from sufficient. first_tok in {m,k} with t in 3-5 covers 94% of mass at 0.6% precision, and the best conjunctions found (m k start, t 3-5, plus extra k/g/u/2 conditions) reach only F1 ~0.21-0.24 with ~40% mass recall. No coherent predicate was found; the feature looks like a specific hidden-state combination of early m/k tokens. It never fires during copying or at t<3.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=m (+6.80), orig0=k (+2.91), prev_tok=u (+2.82), orig1=k (+2.68), prev2_tok=k (+2.63), prev3_tok=k (+2.48). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.69), prev3_tok=- (-2.46), phase=2 (-2.08), prev_tok=m (-1.62).
